messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Erkki, TRN-112 after yesterday's maintenance: RX level low on 1/1/2, about 6 dB worse than before. Swap the SFP?

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Did they unplug the fibre during the work?

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Clean the connector first. Click-cleaner on both ends. A dirty connector is way more common than a bad SFP

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Cleaned both. RX back to normal 👍

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: There you go. Don't throw away good SFPs 😄
